tools.name: generate_teardown
tools.title: Generate product teardown
tools.description: Generate a LinkedIn-style product teardown post about a real product, app, or website, including good/improve insights and (optionally) web-search sources.

product.description: Product name or website URL, e.g. 'Spotify' or 'https://linear.app'.

focus.description: Which aspect of the product experience to focus the teardown on.

notes.description: Optional personal observations to weave into the post.

appStoreId.description: Optional Apple App Store numeric ID or apps.apple.com URL to pull real reviews.

useWebSearch.description: Ground the teardown with live web search results.

tools.name: generate_prd
tools.title: Generate PRD & product strategy
tools.description: Pitch an app or software idea and get a brutally honest PRD in markdown: verdict, personas, keep/add/kill feature breakdown, core user flow, and monetization strategy.

idea.description: The product or app idea to analyze, in a sentence or a few paragraphs.

model.description: Which AI brain to route the analysis through.
